title: Environmental Pollution
notes: Normal composition of atmospheric air is 78.
4% water vapour and remaining amount other gases.
Various chemicals, smoke, particles, gases etc.
are released to the atmosphere by both manmade and natural cause resulting in the alteration of natural quality of atmosphere which is air pollution.
Air pollution impacts adversely on the status of natural resources, health of plants, animals including human beings.
Any substances polluting or altering the originality of air are called air pollutants.
SOURCES Major sources of air pollution are illustrated below: a.

Natural sources Dust storms, volcanic gases, emission of natural gases, pollens, spores, methane produced by decaying plants and animal, release of methane trapped in arctic region etc in nature itself cause air pollution.
